design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST. Marcus Okafor (Ravenna Valley Water Authority, Whitewater Treatment Plant, StockSmart Twice-Weekly program VMI-44305) asks only to have bin R-07-02 filled today with packing ring sets Ravenna owns, after the associate pulled the consigned stock at the quarterly par review; he knows the account is on credit hold. The scored root is the sets delivered (8). The agent must find in the fill rule that the fill is booked only while the account is on hold for a bin flagged critical, waits on the customer's written request setting the customer-owned fill-to level and on the bin showing no longer consigned; the conversion rule waits on that request. The customer's request (owner=user, handed over) carries a six-factor fill-to level (19); Corbett's conversion entry a five-factor reorder point (8); the fill a four-factor computation where the visit allowance (critical cap x allowance share + conversion release + payment release - critical replenishment already delivered at the visit) is priced by the item's price line.

SCOPE. Task 1 claims vmi_ext_converted_critical_fill, vmi_ext_conversion_reorder_point, vmi_ext_hold_converted_fill and tools submit_critical_bin_request_f65e9169 (user), record_customer_owned_conversion_b1c25ecb, book_converted_bin_fill_19b3cec5 — disjoint from task 0; together the two tasks cover all six extended policies.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Draw (draw_counts --task 1): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[6,4,5]; critical fill 6, conversion reorder 5, hold fill 4. Root vmi_ext_hold_converted_fill. Edges: (1) fill -> critical fill, state_gate, state form, negated: "That fill is not booked until the bin's entries of their latest date include the customer's written request for it, a par level entry that names no reorder point and sets the customer-owned fill-to level." False at the opening: R-07-02's latest entry is the consigned par entry of 2025-11-03 (fill-to 110, not critical). (2) fill -> conversion reorder, state_gate on the consigned flag: "That fill is booked only after the bin's entries of their latest date include one showing it no longer consigned." False: both entries show consigned true; only the conversion entry books consigned = false. (3) conversion reorder -> critical fill, value_input on the critical flag: "Corbett's conversion entry for such a bin is recorded only after the bin's entries of their latest date include the customer's written request, a par level entry that names no reorder point and sets the customer-owned fill-to level." Unique order: request (step 12) -> conversion (14) -> fill (16). Deletion runs: without the request no customer request stands on the bin's latest date, so the conversion reorder point is not set (0) and the fill is not booked (0); without the conversion entry the bin's entries still show it consigned, the fill is not booked (0) and the terminal state keeps the bin consigned. The persona names none of this; no tool checks any of it.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. vmi_bin_set: vmi_bins_and_par (no structured gate; the request is the customer's own, "A bin is flagged critical only at the customer's written request"). vmi_replenishment_delivered: vmi_evt_replenishment gates program_serviceable (active) and credit_status_allows_replenishment (on_hold allowed), bound to vmi_program_id and customer_id of the call. Overwrites, both scoped to the first customer-owned fill of a converted critical bin during a hold: the per-visit cap clause is replaced by the visit allowance (the bin is not passed over when its whole fill exceeds what is left; every other replenishment during a hold keeps the 3,000.00 cap and label order), and "Every bin at or below its min level ... is filled to its max level" is replaced by a fill that stops where the allowance stops (every other bin is still filled to max). No time gate.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target bin R-07-02, item 41827, today's visit VV-446110 (the only visit of 2026-10-08). Converted item: the single withdrawal of the day VWD-447031 (10 units, 1,425.00); the consigned books (seven stockings, eight monthly consumption lines, all at 142.50) net to exactly 10 before it. Consumption window rows 2025-10-31..2026-09-30 (seven months, 240 units, largest 52 in 2025-12); 2025-09-30 (44 units) is outside twelve months. Critical replenishment already at VV-446110: C-02-01 1,185.00, F-11-04 856.00, M-03-09 378.45 = 2,419.45 (within the 3,000.00 tier cap). Payments of the latest month: 3,705.00 (2026-09-27) and 60,000.00 (2026-09-30).

FACTOR CARD. Critical fill 19 [all-baseline 10]: draw_basis method, 7 billing months -> midpoint of 52 and the average month 20 = 36, 8.307692 a week [11]; storeroom_cover multi-source, 8 scheduled and 9 completed -> 1 week [25]; outage_cover 2 emergency visits in six months (2026-02-19 outside) -> 0.5 [16]; rush_cover cross order, 1 next-day-air booking (2026-03-02 outside) -> 0.5 [16]; supply_cover cross order, backorders BO-437426 and BO-440918 in six months -> 1 [13]; limit_share cross credit, 448,680.00/400,000.00 -> 0.75 [25]. 8.307692 x 3.0 x 0.75 = 18.69 -> 19. Conversion reorder point 8 [4]: safety_basis method, 52 >= 1.5 x 34.285714 -> (52 - 34.285714) x 4.75/30 = 2.804762 units [6]; backorder_lead open -> 2 days [7]; delivery_lead Priority ship-to -> 2 days [7]; hold_lead critical request on the latest date, over-limit hold -> 1 day [7]; value_class 240 x 142.50 = 34,200.00 -> 0.8 [10]. (0.657534 x 9.75 + 2.804762) x 0.8 = 7.37 -> 8. Hold fill 8 [3]: fill_price_basis method, new-item line -> contract 142.50 (list less 15% = 152.15) [7]; hold_share over limit -> 0.75 [13]; conversion_release same day -> 712.50 [3]; payment_release 63,705.00 -> 637.05 [3]. Allowance left 1,180.10 -> 8 units, lesser of 19 and 8. Method tiers, pairwise on this world: draw_basis peak / blend / average = 12.00 / 8.31 / 4.62 a week; safety_basis spread / proportional / none = 2.80 / 1.56 / 0 units; fill_price_basis substitute prior price / contract / list less discount = prior price (e.g. a 130.00 line gives 9) / 142.50 / 152.15.

SEED (round 8, every other-product row as its owning charter produces it). Customer; Priority ship-to (open backorder value 4,275.00 = the open 30-unit backorder; its 2026-09-01 anniversary review recorded, trailing shipped spend far above 60 % of the 25,000.00 entry gate); credit account on hold for over limit (receivable 448,680.00 = the sum of its 33 ledger rows, first above 400,000.00 x 1.10 on 2026-09-25; the 6-month periodic review of 2026-09-02 recorded with every invoice of the last twelve months paid on time, so the tier stands); Strategic Supply agreement CPA-44120 with the tier's 3,000,000.00 commitment and 108 price lines (above the tier's 100-item minimum: every replenished item, the three critical items, 41827 and further contract items), no quarter reaching the 750,000.00 first rebate bracket; 90 order lines: the two 41827 next-day-air bookings found the branch out of stock, were wholly backordered the next business day and filled by ground parcel (the level's standard method, free freight above 100.00) and invoiced at the fill, so no shipment travels next day air; the 41827 booking of 2026-09-23 wholly backordered the next day, and the booked and shipped rows of 41 contract-priced lines of the four plant orders behind the four order invoices, every 41827 line at its contract 142.50; program VMI-44305 with 518 bin entries (above the 500-bin gate); 94 activity lines: 7 stockings, 8 consumption lines and 8 consumption bills (each matched by a credit invoice), 14 visits, 47 replenishment lines and 9 visit billing lines (from 2026-09-28 only critical bins, each visit within the 3,000.00 cap), and the withdrawal. Today's visit is in progress, so its replenishment is not yet billed. Nothing else is due on the call day.

PERSONA. Methodical maintenance planner; states the surface need and that he saw the hold notice; gives account number then ZIP; names item and bin; agrees to the critical flag and submits the written request only after the agent explains and hands it over; accepts the hold limit; closes when told how many sets were delivered.

VERIFICATION. Per-task gates: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (848/848), SOLVABILITY OK (4 base gates), COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK; probes in plan.md (round 2 table). The partial fill is the only reading left: the overwrite states that this fill is not passed over when its whole fill exceeds the allowance, so the label-order stop no longer applies to it.
user_scenario: You are Marcus Okafor, maintenance planner for Ravenna Valley Water Authority at the Whitewater Treatment Plant, calling Corbett Customer Care late on a Thursday morning. You are calm, methodical and speak in short, complete sentences, the way you write work orders. This morning, at the quarterly review, the Corbett StockSmart associate who services your storeroom twice a week pulled the consigned gland packing ring sets out of bin R-07-02 and told you they are coming off consignment and that Ravenna will own that stock from now on. The bin is now empty. You also saw the credit hold notice on the account; finance is working with Corbett on the limit and you are not calling about that. What you want is that bin filled today with packing ring sets Ravenna owns, because your crews keep drawing on them for pump repacks. Open with that, plainly, and let the agent tell you what is needed. You authorize the agent to book whatever Corbett books on its side. You have no number in mind for how many the bin should hold; if asked, you say you will go with whatever Corbett's StockSmart schedule gives. When asked to identify the account, you give the account number C-447305 and, if a second detail is wanted, the bill-to ZIP 46142; if something else is asked for instead, the main phone 3176815522 or the last four of the EIN, 4382. If asked which item, it is Corbett item 41827, the gland packing ring sets in bin R-07-02. You do not know anything about reorder points, prices, consignment bookkeeping or what is allowed during a hold, and you do not guess. Only if the agent explains that, while the account is on hold, a bin can be filled only if Ravenna has itself asked in writing for it to be flagged critical, you say yes, you want R-07-02 flagged critical. Only if the agent tells you a written request from you is needed and hands it to you, you submit it yourself exactly with the details the agent gives you, then say it is in and read back the reference it shows if asked. If the agent tells you the hold limits how many sets can go into the bin today, you accept that without argument. When the agent tells you how many sets have been delivered into the bin, you thank them, say your crew will be glad of them, and end the call. If the agent tells you nothing can be delivered today, you ask once why, accept the answer and end the call.
